title: ProspectiveHypothesisSourceValidity
description: One judgement of one frozen hypothesis under one version of the contamination rules. The file holding these is append-only: a hypothesis is judged again whenever the rules change, and both judgements stay, because the difference between them is the record of when the standard moved.

dimension.description: The cohort the hypothesis splits on.

source_field.description: The return the historical analysis measured this horizon with. The judgement is about that pairing, not about how the hypothesis would be evaluated prospectively.

verdict.description: invalid: the rules name this pairing as unsound. valid: the rules cover the cohort and the pairing holds. undeclared: the rules have nothing to say about this cohort, so it was passed by default rather than checked — a gap in the rules, not a finding about the hypothesis.

reason.description: Why, in the rules' own words. Null only where there is nothing to say.

contamination_rules_sha256.description: The version of the rules that produced this verdict. Without it, `invalid` cannot be told apart from `invalid under a rule that did not exist yet`.
